description:
Adversarial review of the 14-TODO holistic-review remediation found a systemic
gap: several PRs landed real regression reproducers but parked them in
non-required CI lanes (manual env var, `slow`, `integration`/`medium`), so the
develop required gate `ci-required-result` does NOT execute them. The PR that
introduced each reproducer self-merged without ever running its own deepest
guard; the reproducers only fire one ring out, at the main-release boundary
(test.yml). Three concrete instances:

  1. #900 (plan-capture-blocking-ci-gate): the "gate catches a planted defect"
     proof is gated only by env var BENCHBOX_PLANT_PLAN_CAPTURE_GATE_DEFECT
     (tests/integration/test_plan_capture_gate.py:88), which NOTHING in CI sets.
     w3's no-silent-green claim is satisfied only as a one-time manual demo;
     there is no standing automated negative test.
  2. #901 (cross-surface-mutation-harness-scale-fidelity): the substantive
     mutation-catch assertions (test_mutation_sensitivity,
     test_unmutated_target_is_green) are module `slow`-marked and excluded from
     the required code-test lane; only the set-equality drift guard
     (test_targets_cover_every_enforced_gate, -m slow -n 0) runs in required CI.
  3. #909 (plan-capture-robustness-hardening): the w2 connection-fencing and w3
     plan-identity reproducers live in tests/integration/test_plan_capture_phase.py
     ([integration, medium]) and run only in test.yml; no required develop-PR
     job collects them.

Design principle this item establishes: a regression reproducer that proves a
fix MUST run in the required develop-PR gate, via an explicit-node step if its
marker excludes it from the fast lane. Cost is bounded by selecting only the
load-bearing cells, not whole slow matrices.

anti_patterns.dont: add a step without verifying it actually fails when the fix is reverted (w4).
add the reproducers as a new non-required job or with continue-on-error
anti_patterns.why: that recreates the gap this item closes.
cost-blow-up; promote the specific cells that prove the fixes.

deferrals.reason: Scope this item to the three holistic-review instances; a full sweep is a separate hygiene pass.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: Reason explicitly scopes the broader audit as separate hygiene work, which matches the open item promote-non-required-regression-reproducers-suite-audit.
deferrals.summary: Broader audit of every non-required reproducer across the suite.

preserves.behavior: Every added step lives in a job already in ci-required-result.needs and is not continue-on-error.
No new always-on slow matrix in required CI — select only the load-bearing cells; keep wall-clock bounded.
The existing positive-path gate behavior and the fast-lane test selection are unchanged.

work_units.notes:
From a fresh worktree off develop: grep BENCHBOX_PLANT_PLAN_CAPTURE_GATE_DEFECT
across the repo (expect: only the test reads it, nothing sets it); confirm
test_cross_surface_mutation_sensitivity.py module pytestmark includes slow;
confirm test_plan_capture_phase.py module pytestmark is [integration, medium];
confirm pr.yml code-test (test (ubuntu-latest, 3.12)) and plan-capture-gate
are in ci-required-result.needs. Record a compact summary (file:line, marker,
lane) in the PR body. Line numbers in this TODO are from origin/develop at
review time and may have drifted. NOTE: cli-lean-import-guarantee's w7 also
edits pr.yml's required lanes; if that item is in flight, coordinate/rebase to
avoid a conflict on the required-CI workflow (a merge-coordination concern, not
a logical dependency).
work_units.summary: Re-confirm the three gaps on fresh develop before editing (markers, env-var usages, lane membership)

work_units.notes:
Add test (or CI step) that runs the plan-capture gate subprocess with
BENCHBOX_PLANT_PLAN_CAPTURE_GATE_DEFECT=1 and asserts NON-ZERO exit (the gate
catches the dropped fingerprint). Wire it into the required plan-capture-gate
job (Makefile plan-capture-gate target region) or as an explicit node in
code-test. The positive path must stay green with the env var unset. This
regression-protects the catch capability itself, not just the happy path.
work_units.summary: Add a standing automated negative test that the plan-capture gate fails on a planted defect (#900 F3)

work_units.notes:
Add an explicit-node step to code-test invoking the h2odb mutation-sensitivity
cell plus test_unmutated_target_is_green[h2odb] with -m "slow" -n 0 (mirroring
pr.yml:357). h2odb is the gate whose scale-fidelity #901 fixed; its build now
matches production (gate.scale_factor=0.01). Leave the full slow matrix where
it is. Confirm the exact parametrized node ids against the live test file.
work_units.summary: Promote the load-bearing mutation-catch cells into required code-test (#901 F4)

work_units.notes:
Add an explicit-node step to code-test:
  uv run -- python -m pytest tests/integration/test_plan_capture_phase.py \
    -m "medium" -n 0 -k "<identity/fencing/timeout selectors>" --tb=short -q
covering the connection-fencing (w2) and plan-identity (w3) reproducers.
Confirm the -k selectors against the actual test names before merge.
work_units.summary: Add the w2/w3 plan-capture-phase reproducers to a required develop-PR job (#909 F5)

work_units.notes:
For each added step, locally break the underlying fix and confirm the required
step goes red; restore. Record the manual break/restore evidence (command +
observed failure) in the PR body. Do NOT commit the breakage. This guards
against adding a vacuous required step that never fails.
work_units.summary: Prove each new required step is load-bearing (fails when its fix is reverted)
